commands.command: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; O=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); printf 'ORIGIN=%s\n' "$O"; case "$O" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s
' '=== CHECKOUT ==='; git -C "$P" status --short --branch; printf '%s
' '=== WORKTREES ==='; git -C "$P" worktree list --porcelain; printf '%s
' '=== MAIN ==='; printf 'LOCAL_MAIN='; git -C "$P" rev-parse main; printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN='; git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main; printf 'MAIN_AHEAD_BEHIND='; git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main
